name: @veren/zhihu-ops-bundle
description: Use when a DSH profile needs the Zhihu operations-analysis application installed and composed in one step: it is a configuration-only bundle whose patch inserts the single zhihu-ops row - the daily pull, the durable snapshots, the derived metrics, the four pages and the report delivery all live inside that one app, so there are no toggles; the application framework (app registry, page registry, task center, app-host) rides in through the @veren/app-host-bundle dependency, and the member plugin ships as a plain dependency without a bundle declaration of its own, so this patch is the stack's only profile layer; skip it when you want to compose the app row by row in your own patch.
